title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Upfront Fee — Schedule Computation Clause
content:
**Clause.** The upfront lock fee on a Builder Extended Rate Lock is the greater of the upfront fee percent of the loan amount on the lock, rounded half up to the cent, and the term's minimum upfront fee, and is zero where the term's upfront fee percent is zero. The upfront fee percent is the upfront fee percent of the lock's term.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Loan amount on the lock | the lock record |
| Upfront fee percent and minimum upfront fee | the product's upfront fee schedule for the lock's term |

## Formation of the fee

- On a term whose upfront fee percent is zero, the fee is zero.
- On any other term, the percent of the loan amount is rounded half up to the cent and compared with the minimum; the fee is the greater of the two.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Loan amount | Upfront fee percent | Minimum | Percent of the loan amount, rounded | Upfront lock fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 400000.00 | 0.250 | USD 500.00 | 1000.00 | USD 1000.00 |
| USD 150000.00 | 0.250 | USD 500.00 | 375.00 | USD 500.00 |
| USD 333333.00 | 0.500 | USD 1000.00 | 1666.665, so 1666.67 | USD 1666.67 |
| USD 500000.00 | 0.000 | USD 0.00 | — | USD 0.00 |
